Name: More Quest
Author: wpfmti
Description:
[size=3][color=#f4f4f4]This mod adds approximately 70 quests of a type similar to vanilla.[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]From spring of the first year to winter of the second year, you can receive 7 to 9 quests by mail every month.[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]There are many different types of quests, such as crop harvesting, bringing items, and finding lost items.[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]In this mod, quests come from a fixed date of the first spring. So the mod won't work well if you use it on a character you've already played. Starting a new save file is required.[/color][/size]

[size=3]There are three levels of difficulty. 
The higher the difficulty, the higher the amount of items required for the quest, so it may take a long time to achieve. 
Therefore, if you want to enjoy it lightly, I recommend easy and regular difficulty.
[/size][color=#d9d2e9]

[color=#ffe599][b][ [size=4]Noted Items[/size] ][/b]

[size=3][b]1. Catch the Spring Legend fish after the arrival of the related quests after the second year.

2. Delivery quests must give items of the same quality(e.g., normal, silver, or gold) to NPC.

3. LostItem quests used ordinary items that are easy to get without using unique items like 'Lewis' Lucky Puple Shorts'.[/b]

Therefore, if the lost item is disappeared for any reason, you can complete the quest by getting a new item in any way and giving it to the requester.
*Usually, the cause of the disappearance of lost items is destruction by obstructing the movement of the npc, or if you have obtained the same items (fishing, mining, etc.) while you have not yet gone to collect lost items.*
[/size][/color]
